heading: Blood bank

screening.description: Record each infection test once. All negative clears the unit for stock.

crossmatch.groupNone: The patient has no blood group on record.
crossmatch.groupUnavailable: The patient's blood group is not available to you.
crossmatch.validity: A compatible result is good for 72 hours.

reaction.description: For a unit that was issued or transfused.

reaction.severityHint: It can be raised later, never lowered.

update.description: The reaction is now {{severity}}. An update can only raise it.
update.severityHint: Leave as is, or raise it.

trace.title: Trace of unit {{number}}
trace.description: Where the unit came from and where it went.

donor.description: People who give blood. Names and phone numbers are hidden here; open a donor to see them.
donor.dateOfBirthHint: A donor is 18 to 65 years old.

edit.description: Correct the name, date of birth, sex or phone. The blood group and the number never change.
edit.savedMeanwhile: Someone else saved this donor first. Your changes are kept; the fields you did not change show what was saved.

register.title: Register a donor
register.description: A donor is a person of the blood bank, not a patient. The number is made for you.

detail.description: The whole record. Opening it is kept in the audit log.

collection.description: Each unit made is group {{group}} (the donor's group) and goes to testing next. A donation can make up to four units.
collection.duplicateNumber: Two units in this collection have the same number.

defer.description: A deferred donor cannot give blood. A deferral is never shortened.
